Done when: a reviewer fires on a new packet without manual help, with the cause named. [2026-11-19 14:15Z AM-OPS-8] DIAGNOSED. Not the PAT.

Evidence (live reads, 14:01-14:10Z):
- ltr_wake_post_receipt at 14:01:45Z: state already_posted, due_count 7. The marker read SUCCEEDED; no 403 in this path.
- GET /api/bot/wake-toggles: ltr_paper=false, flipped by the operator from the console at 2026-11-08T07:41:05Z. ltr_real_money and ltr_prop are true.
- live_review_fires log: the LAST VM routine fire was 2026-11-14T02:19Z, so the VM has fired no reviewer for 5 days.
- trader journal: due=6 from 13:23Z, due=7 at 13:43Z. The packet 'evidence LR-20261119T1344Z-pkg-6dacfc6b3cfb4c03' landed on live-review/rows at 13:44Z.

ROOT CAUSE (code): src/runtime/live_review_wake_post.py builds and commits the packet evidence, then applies the wake toggles (line 467, wake.apply_toggles), and only then calls the routine fire (line 481).
- With ltr_paper off, every paper entry is dropped BEFORE the fire. The packet lands, but no reviewer session starts and no comment posts.
- That is the observed shape exactly.
- The rows that landed until 09:22Z (mirrored to main in #27195 at 07:35Z and #27248 at 10:05Z) came from reviewers started some other way, not from the VM fire.

CONTRACT MISMATCH: wake_toggles.py's docstring says a toggle 'never decides what trades, what is reviewed, or whether a packet is built'. Because the toggle is applied before the fire, in practice it DOES decide whether a paper package is reviewed. The live-trade-review skill scopes review to every account, paper included (operator 2026-10-26 'All accounts now').

FIX OPTIONS (manager decides):
- (a) Fire before the toggle, so the toggle withholds only the comment. Tier 2 runtime: it restarts the trader. It also spends plan usage on paper reviews.
- (b) Keep paper off the auto-fire path and have the manager batch paper reviews (as now). Then correct the docstring.
